_about: Routing evals: for each query, whether relay-recap's recapping-a-relay skill should fire first. `expect` lists the acceptable skills; [] means no relay-recap skill should fire. Queries are made up and contain no personal data. Run with tests/run_trigger_evals.py.

cases.query: Our 12-person Ragnar team just finished. I have a folder of FIT files from everyone's Garmins (./ragnar_fits/). Can you stitch them into one activity for the whole relay?
Hood to Coast recap: I've got GPX exports from 9 of our 12 runners, three legs never got recorded because watches died. I want one continuous track with the missing legs filled in somehow.
two of my teammates' watches overlap by like 40 minutes on leg 14 of our relay (one of them paced the other). how do I merge all the legs into a single file without double counting?
I want to upload our whole team's 200-mile relay as one Strava activity. Files are a mix of Coros .fit and Strava GPX downloads in ./legs. What's the safest way to combine and upload it?
Make a shareable route map page for our relay team showing every leg colored by runner, built from the watch files in ./tracks/, with a phone-sized PNG I can drop in the group chat.
Can you turn our ekiden team's GPS files into one of those 3D flythrough videos of the course, with a little animation at every baton handoff?
Here's my GPX from this morning's half marathon (run.gpx). What were my mile splits and where did my pace fall off?
Write me a 16-week marathon training plan to go from a 4:10 to sub-3:45, running 5 days a week.
I have a 20-minute GoPro video of our team relay race. Cut it into five vertical 30-second YouTube Shorts with captions.
Build an Excel sheet of our relay team's split times per leg with a running total and average pace per runner. I'll paste the times from the results page.
Draft this month's running club newsletter: welcome new members, recap the relay we ran last weekend, and announce the Thursday track sessions.
My Garmin FIT file shows heart rate spikes to 220 during an easy run. Is that a sensor glitch, and how can I clean it out of the file?
